blurb: Guests fish for species like Black Sea Bass, Tautog, Bluefin Tuna, and Shark on Cape Cod Bay. The captain provides bait and tackle, and will fillet and bag the catch at the end of the trip. The boat is a 34-foot SeaVee center console with amenities including seating, restroom, music, and safety gear.
